original_proof_verdict: incomplete as written: two finite-word assertions are false

repairs.failed_assertion: Excluding a retained endpoint from every open-word coordinate average costs only a small flatness or lower-entry error.
repairs.repair: For a diagonal even alternating word with no boundary insertion, the omitted endpoint contributes a leading negative product. The alternating two-boundary word supplies the compensating product after lower diagonal moments are replaced by their references. The remaining merged-gap and one-boundary counts give k/q. This is compensation in the ideal drift polynomial, not a pathwise identity.

repairs.failed_assertion: Every interior-insertion word has a small retained-to-eliminated lower-power endpoint.
repairs.repair: Both-boundary interior words can lack that endpoint. Treat their full raw second moments separately, using averaged squared products of two scattering entries and the bounded top-order diagonal cap; this yields C_k delta_u/u. Other interior words use the lower-entry envelope.
